concept: S3 Block Public Access: prevent public access
tests: How to guarantee a bucket never becomes public, whatever ACLs or bucket policies are added later.
expected: S3 Block Public Access at the bucket or whole-account level overrides public ACLs and policies. Triggers: "cannot be made public regardless of bucket policies or ACLs".
why_not: Versioning protects against overwrites; a VPC endpoint is a network path; an explicit allow in a policy does the opposite — opens access.
